scope: authored specification; not implementation or learner certification

items.evidence: Amina's goals distinguish career and life aims; the portfolio asks the learner for a tentative direction and life priority. A fictional response alone is not personal-goal evidence.
Distinguish exploration clusters from NOC groups and compare the two dated occupation records.
Connect a direction to preparation and a supplied course chain; real prerequisites are not inferred.
A complete fictional school plan is constructed; an actual personal school/graduation/admission plan remains unverified.
Name a specific transition question, available support and checkpoint rather than assuming a service has approved anything.
Recalculate weekly capacity, protect rest/buffer and revise digital/time habits.
Changed offerings, transport or priorities trigger a specific feasible revision.
Compare dated profiles and supplied local/provincial measures without treating a provincial claim as a local vacancy guarantee.
Compare route-to-role progression, training and venture/employment alternatives.
Scenario reflection is supplemented by a learner's tentative aspirations; no assessment infers a career from a quiz label.
Use observable course work to form a cautious strength/growth claim; a fictional person's strength does not establish the learner's.
Inspect profile/provider/posting requirements and match truthful evidence. No universal employer or credential requirement is invented.
Compare complete supplied route records; optional current-page verification is distinct from this research exercise.
Revise from supplied feedback, with a portfolio explanation of an actual course-answer improvement.
Self-assess an actual course learning action. This is not proof of employment performance.
Develop precise preparation/networking questions and improvement actions; sending or receiving a real professional message is not required.
Investigate supplied responsibilities, permissions and training records before acting.

items.location: No course activity claims this outcome
items.evidence: No supervised school/community work experience will occur. Online simulations and completion checks do not satisfy participation.
Reflect on a supplied simulated experience; actual work-related experience reflection is not established.
Revise a fictional route from simulated feedback. No claim of updating an actual personal program after real work experience.
Compare part-time, temporary, seasonal, self-employed and multiple-job time/cost constraints.
Prepare and revise context–action–result interview evidence, without inventing paid employment or credentials.
Use dated Alberta OHS records to distinguish hazard response, training and statutory process.
Identify employer/worker obligations, role authority, evidence and a proportionate concern route.

Use age, industry, school/time facts and current source records; distinguish hours rules from payroll arithmetic. Overtime, vacation, holidays and ending-employment categories are explained in CO2-03 §3 without adding unsupported entitlement rates.
Identify a rights concern, missing facts, documentation and the appropriate official route without declaring a legal outcome.
Explain how context and priorities affect the available choices; personal financial disclosure is unnecessary.
Reconcile hours, rate, gross, current deductions, net and YTD; diagnose a missing shift.
Evaluate supplied future purchases against timing, total cost and constraints.
Explain urgency, social influence or promotion without treating an emotion as proof of affordability.
Compare reasons for spending, saving and debt choices without assigning moral worth to a person's finances.
Separate upfront, recurring and uncertain costs; compare ownership/rental alternatives.
Find cash-flow shortfalls and repair a plan using confirmed options rather than additional unconfirmed borrowing.
Compare promotional periods, device/setup costs, cancellation and recurring commitments on a common timeline.
Explain cost and timing consequences of borrowing compared with a fully supplied nonborrowing option.
Subtract fixed debt repayment from uncertain asset proceeds; borrowing amplifies downside as well as potential gain.
Reserve contractual minima, allocate extra money, compare strategies and identify an infeasible payment budget.
Keep rate and time units consistent; explain interest, principal and changing balances.
Compare specified fixed/variable rate paths, reset payments, total cost and budget margin; no prediction of actual rates.
Use shorter/longer schedules and distinguish mortgage term from amortization.
Compare product terms, fees, security and application information without entering a real application or promising approval.
Learner changes a stated input, calculates and interprets output. Implementation must supply the working tool; a screenshot alone is insufficient.
Compare principal, term, rate convention, prepayment privilege and renewal balance with supplied mortgage offers.
Revise goals and resources as life stages or actual case circumstances change.
Match a support question to a calculator, official program/product information or appropriately qualified service; compensation/limits matter.
Coordinate deposits, protect priorities and explain the next-best alternative.
Read supplied official product/account records, including registered vs nonregistered and named account purposes.
Match near/long goals, access, risk and fictional eligibility/contribution room without equating account label with safety.
Evaluate a coordinated plan against its shared money, target, deadline and changed conditions.
Change a fee/return/inflation or budget input and interpret the result. Implementation must preserve the stated calculation convention.
Explain volatile market value and why a forecast is not cash already available for a fixed deadline.
Compare price change, nominal balance and real purchasing power; distinguish a lower inflation rate from falling prices.
Analyze liquidity, uncertainty, diversification limits, fees and the conditions under which risk may fit a goal.
Explain how visible information combines into a financial-security risk.
Use dated Alberta/Competition Bureau records to analyze price/contract concerns and proper routes without declaring an automatic remedy.
Identify indicators across investment, job, emergency, purchase and relationship fraud examples.
Classify by mechanism while recognizing overlapping labels; explain evidence rather than guessing from spelling.
Choose protections matched to data, credentials, sessions and recovery routes actually exposed.
Connect each protective action with the risk it reduces and its remaining limit.
Use dated cyber-security records for minimal sharing, unique credentials, MFA, independent access and review habits.
Analyze distinct exposure/payment/identity cases and adjust to new confirmed information.
Choose specific provider, police, CAFC, credit-bureau or statutory routes with their distinct roles and limits.
